subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased, or replace/adopt it with a maintainer-owned narrow fix?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is outside the target repository, conflicting, and not maintainer-modifiable.

options.title: Replace or adopt the fix
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR after the replacement exists.

options.title: Ask for a contributor rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main with maintainer edits enabled if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave both items open until the contributor updates the fork PR, accepting that the known UI/TUI leak remains unresolved meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the fix
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to both the original shared sanitizer boundary and the TUI leading-stripper path, which are the central surfaces for the decision.
